decision: Extend only the R2 standby and scientific-runner start fences because the original standby fence fell below the scheduler's 120-second admission runway before R2 was admitted. All science, owner-transition, claim-generation, terminal, release, spend, and provider identities remain unchanged.

lifecycle_override.fit_basis: The replacement receives more than the measured 332-second owner-repair duration plus the 120-second scheduler/start runway. Inputs and the pinned image are already resident; after takeover the unchanged component still has over ten minutes to the terminal target and over three minutes for retrieval and generation-fenced release.

required_action: Read the base binding and this amendment once. Implement only the named owner-R2 and transition-launcher files, publish the base binding's R2 ready terminal, and execute its standby-first exact-PID same-claim transition under these amended lifecycle fences.
